name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students
description: Scholarship to girl students admitted to technical degree or diploma courses in AICTE approved institutions.
benefits: ₹50,000 per annum for every year of technical study

criteria.description: Applicant must be a female student
criteria.disqualification_reason: Pragati scholarship is exclusively for female students

criteria.description: Applicant must be an enrolled student
criteria.disqualification_reason: Applicant is not enrolled as a student

criteria.description: Applicant must be enrolled in a technical degree or diploma course
criteria.disqualification_reason: Applicant is not enrolled in a recognized technical degree or diploma course

criteria.description: Family income must not exceed ₹8,00,000 per annum
criteria.disqualification_reason: Family annual income exceeds ₹8 Lakh limit
